sample_row_decisions.evidence_summary: The sampled APD6 row is source-backed at layer 1: linked_literature_records row 3 maps APD6:AP05588 to DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-60051-6, PMID 40645962, and PMCID PMC12254355; paper.xml article metadata confirms the same DOI/PMID/PMCID; the final database record cites Supplementary Table 2 row UniprotKB-4 with primary sequence LKLKSILGKLGVIL and no reported terminal/D-amino-acid/cyclization/lipidation/disulfide modification. Layer 2 context is also row-level and source-located for this peptide, with 11 MIC rows plus CC50 and HC50 rows carrying units, targets, and source-data or supplementary-table locators. The row is not accepted cleanly because the paper-level accepted mechanism artifact contains a non-standard evidence_class value, which is a hard rework condition under the validation420 prompt.
